newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Heavy rains close Philippine government offices.
newsitem.headline: Heavy rains close Philippine government offices.

text.p: The Philippine presidential palace on Monday shut Manila's government offices, including state-controlled companies, because of heavy rains and flooding in the capital.
Deputy Executive Secretary Luis Liwanag said in a statement only agencies performing vital functions were required to maintain a skeleton force. Offices will reopen on Tuesday.
The city's financial markets came to a halt along with much of the capital following three days of heavy rains that have cut power supplies and made roads impassable.
